text:
sasha: Planning EdenFlow dedicated rollout tomorrow — proposing 04:00 UTC to avoid KMS rotation clash. Need final sign-off on version pin and rollback thresholds. Proposed: pin model image redwood/model-llama-2-quant:v2.1-pin and runtime inf-runtime:2026.03. Canary on slice-17 with 10% -> 50% -> 100% windows (30m). Rollback triggers: p95 latency >250ms OR error rate >1.5% sustained 5m. Any objections?

tariq: ACK timeline but heads-up, KMS rotation is scheduled 03:00–03:15 UTC for edenflow. That overlap is why I flagged earlier. Can we confirm we really want 04:00 (cool by me) — otherwise collision risk. @kelsey?

kelsey: We cannot shift KMS earlier, it's a vendor slot. 04:00 UTC looks safe. Please keep a 30m buffer after KMS completion. Also request we pin encryption key version in the deploy config (kms_key_version: v3).

ella: Ops prefers rollout after KMS, 04:00 is fine. Suggest we use quant-profile q8-fast for this tenant (latency-sensitive). Also add KV cache warmup step in the pre-hook.

ryan: I'll own release notes, canary dashboard, and synthetic probe changes. I'll add a /probe edenflow/echo every 15s and a token-consistency check. Will also add a note about model quantization in the changelog.

sasha: Great. Updated plan: 04:00 UTC, pin model redwood/model-llama-2-quant:v2.1-pin, runtime inf-runtime:2026.03, quant-profile=q8-fast, kms_key_version=v3, canary slice=slice-17. Rollback thresholds unchanged. @deploybot schedule canary at 04:00.

deploybot: Deployment scheduled: edenflow/dedicated @ 04:00 UTC. Canary config: slice=slice-17, canary=10%, windows=30m. Health checks: p50,p95 latency, 5xx rate, token error rate, synthetic probe. To start manual run: `/deploy edenflow dedicated --model redwood/model-llama-2-quant:v2.1-pin --runtime inf-runtime:2026.03 --slice slice-17 --canary 10% --quant q8-fast --kms-version v3`

[04:10 UTC] deploybot: Canary launched to 10% on slice-17. Initial metrics (1m window): p95=128ms, 5xx=0.2%, token errors=0.01%. KV cache warmed on 3/3 hosts.

tariq: LGTM to proceed to 50%. No errors from infra footprint.

deploybot: Rolling to 50% (scheduled window 04:40 UTC for full progress).

[04:35 UTC] deploybot: Alert — p95 spike detected on slice-17: p95=312ms (threshold 250ms). 5xx increased to 1.4%. Condition sustained 6m.

ella: Observed increased tail latency and some NPU saturations on host-gpu-12. Initiating immediate rollback to previous stable revision.

deploybot: Rollback initiated. Traffic shifting back to revision r2026-11-edenflow-prev. All canary traffic removed.

[04:39 UTC] deploybot: Rollback complete. Traffic restored to previous revision. Post-rollback metrics: p95=120ms, 5xx=0.1%. Incident ticket created INC-2026-434 for perf regression investigation.

sasha: Thanks for the quick rollback. We'll pause this rollout until postmortem. Ryan, can you collect traces and the synthetic probe logs for the 04:20–04:40 window?

ryan: On it. I'll upload the probe traces and flamegraphs to the incident ticket and add notes to the release doc.

kelsey: KMS key/v3 looks safe — no encryption errors in the logs. Might be quantization interaction with this runtime kernel selection.

tariq: Agreed. Suggest we reproduce on canary host pool with q8-fast+runtime inf-runtime:2026.03 locally before retrying. Also add a stricter canary rollback hook to auto-cut at 3m sustained breach.

sasha: Agreed to tighten canary guardrails. New plan: repro in staging, add 3m sustained breach auto-rollback, re-run at next window (TBD). Thanks team. :thumbsup:
